GOAL: produce the single in-scope idea for this ideation slot, aiming away from the four already-rejected mechanisms (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ, behcone/succboost/TSG/MIXCURV family) and away from round one (chained curved residual, 2201 L3 prefixes, 0.0544) and round two (geodesic step to popularity-adjusted successor barycentre, 1298 L3 prefixes, 0.05165).
READ: task brief only (no repo access, no write permission); constraints (a) tree-ness unavailable, (b) curvature is a gauge and behaviour-CONTRAST predicts recall (+0.7104) while Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt, (c) origin-minimum objectives collapse the encoder, (d) behaviour must reach the tokens, (e) the only consistently positive signal is deep-prefix capacity (2201 > 1298 corresponds to 0.0544 > 0.05165).
OBSERVED: all previous mechanisms MOVE POINTS (barycentre steps, geodesic shifts, Fréchet codebook means) or ADD A SCALAR PER LEVEL (curvature per level, radial rank, context entropy) - both families are exhausted and both have merged prefixes. No prior mechanism deforms the ASSIGNMENT METRIC per item without moving any point, and none uses a popularity-neutralised successor-versus-non-neighbour CONTRAST direction as an anisotropic tangent direction inside a Mobius displacement.
REASONING: the coupling position chosen is the quantizer cell boundary, not the point position and not the codebook centre: an item-adaptive rank-1 metric M_i = I + lambda_i u_i u_i^T applied inside the Mobius displacement z = (-x) xor_c y, so items that are textual near-duplicates but behaviourally opposed fall on different sides of a codeword boundary at levels 2 and 3. This is capacity-neutral in slots (3x256 frozen) and aims at splitting rather than merging, which is the one direction the two negative rounds never tried. Architecture (3 levels, 256 codes, SID length 3) is deliberately left frozen so the Stage3 protocol is untouched and the single run is a clean test of the coupling.
OPEN: whether the rank-1 anisotropy is strong enough to move 15%+ of deep assignments, and whether it increases rather than decreases distinct L2/L3 prefixes; both are recorded as observables, not gates.
CORRECTION/NOTE: the progress tool was only exposed after the first catalog read, so this record supersedes the assumption that no progress tool exists in this session.

GOAL: pick one in-scope idea for this ideation slot, avoiding round-one (chained curved residual, 2201 L3 prefixes, 0.0544), round-two (geodesic step to popularity-adjusted successor barycentre, 1298 L3 prefixes, 0.05165) and the rejected family (poincare-frechet codebook, CURVCTRL per-level curvature, BRad radial behaviour rank, behcone, succboost, TSG, MIXCURV).
READ: task brief only. Constraints: tree-ness unavailable; curvature is a gauge and behaviour-CONTRAST predicts recall (+0.7104) while Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt; origin-minimum objectives collapse the encoder; behaviour must reach the tokens; the only consistent positive signal is deep-prefix capacity (2201 > 1298 maps to 0.0544 > 0.05165).
OBSERVED: every prior mechanism either MOVES POINTS (barycentre step, geodesic shift, Frechet codebook mean, curved residual chain) or attaches ONE SCALAR PER LEVEL (curvature, radial rank, context entropy, cone). Both families merged prefixes and lost recall.
REASONING: the untried coupling position is the cell BOUNDARY, not the position and not the centre. Proposed BCEM-RQ: a per-item rank-1 metric M_i = I + lambda_i uhat_i uhat_i' applied INSIDE the Mobius displacement z = (-x) xor_c y of a fixed-c=1 Poincare distance, so textual near-duplicates that are behaviourally opposed land in different deep codewords. lambda_i = gamma_i*s_i from a popularity-neutralised (inverse-propensity) successor-versus-non-neighbour contrast in the origin tangent frame, built once from train transitions. Architecture left frozen at 3 levels x 256 codes so SID length and the Stage3 protocol are untouched and the mechanism never adds or merges slots, only tilts which side of a boundary an item falls on. Behaviour reaches tokens via argmin and reaches the encoder via the curved commitment term with the frozen beta (no new weight).
COST ESTIMATE: about 25-50 MFLOP extra per step (1023 items x 3 levels x 256 codes), 0.5-1.5 ms, epoch 0.150 -> 0.160-0.170 s (<= +12%), plus a few seconds one-time precompute.
OPEN/RISK: the bounded anisotropy (condition number <= 2) may be too weak to move 15% of deep assignments, or may coarsen the perpendicular directions and merge prefixes (the exact failure of rounds one and two). Observables: reassignment fraction, distinct L1/L2/L3 counts, usage entropy, radius quantiles, Stage3 test_recall@10.
NOTE: the progress tool appeared only after the first catalog read, superseding the earlier assumption that no write channel existed.

FINAL ANSWER (condensed record of the same idea; full text printed to the user).

IDEA: BCEM-RQ. Behaviour-contrast ellipsoidal Mobius metric inside the RQ-VAE assignment and commitment; no point, no codebook centre and no codebook slot is moved or added.
CHANGE: levels 2 and 3 of the frozen 3x256 RQ-VAE select codewords by d_M(x,y;i) = (2/sqrt(c))*artanh(sqrt(c*z'M_i z)) with z = (-x) xor_c y, c = 1, M_i = I + lambda_i uhat_i uhat_i'; the frozen commitment ||x-y||^2 becomes the same curved squared distance with the same frozen beta.
BEHAVIOUR: directed immediate-successor pairs from the Stage-2 train split; u_i = m_i^+ - m_i^- where m_i^+ is the count-weighted tangent mean of successor initial text embeddings and m_i^- the inverse-popularity-weighted mean of min(n_i,64) seeded non-neighbours; s_i = ||u_i||/(||m_i^+||+||m_i^-||+eps) in [0,1]; gamma_i = n_i/(n_i+n_med); lambda_i = gamma_i*s_i; table frozen for the whole run.
GEOMETRY: fixed negative curvature c = 1, radius 1; exp_0(v) = tanh(sqrt(c)||v||)v/(sqrt(c)||v||), Mobius addition, artanh distance. Level 1 keeps lambda = 0.
CURVATURE CONSTANTS ALL DERIVED: c = 1 by gauge; scale s = 0.9/r99 from the train catalogue 99th percentile; 64 = control cap; seed 1234; n_med = train median out-degree; clamp at 1-1e-3; condition number <= 2 because lambda in [0,1].
COUPLING: the behaviour table sets M_i, M_i enters the Mobius displacement of the argmin that produces the deep tokens, and those same tokens set the curved commitment target that grads into the encoder. Behaviour-off => M_i = I. Geometry-off => c -> 0 Euclidean kernel with the same M_i. Both-on => the single trained arm.
COST: +25-50 MFLOP and 0.5-1.5 ms per step, epoch 0.150 -> 0.160-0.170 s (<= +12%), 3000 epochs about 480-510 s; no new parameters; +3 MB table.
HYPOTHESIS to be kept: reassignment fraction >= 15% versus the epoch-0 lambda = 0 reference, distinct L2/L3 prefixes not below 230/1251/1298, Stage3 test_recall@10 > 0.065 with recall@5 and ndcg@10 agreeing.
RISK: bounded anisotropy too weak, or coarsening the perpendicular directions and merging prefixes exactly as rounds one and two did; contrast direction computed on the initial frozen geometry may drift from the trained encoder geometry; no spare slot to absorb items pushed into crowded cells.
SWITCHES exist and are wired (behavior_off, geometry_off, both_on); only both_on is trained; no ablation, no sweep, no extra seed; diagnostics recorded only; Stage3 protocol frozen.
END.

STAGE: design decision for one new idea (round three, ideation_2, second idea).
GOAL: pick ONE mechanism that (a) satisfies the 5-part scope contract, (b) is consistent with the round-one/round-two negative results, (c) is not one of the already-rejected families (Poincare-Frechet successor codebook, CURVCTRL-SID per-level curvature, BRad-RQ behaviour-ranked radial assignment, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID, concentration-scaled geodesic step toward a successor barycentre (round two)).
WHAT I READ / USED: the round-three brief's three pieces of evidence: (i) prefix capacity separates the runs (L3 2201 -> 0.0544 vs L3 1298 -> 0.0517, baseline ~0.0679), every mechanism so far merged prefixes; (ii) behaviour-CONTRAST predicts recall (+0.7104), Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weightings hurt (-0.12, -0.075), the radial term is group compactness not hierarchy; (iii) curvature is a gauge, and objectives minimised at the ball origin collapse the encoder; (iv) behaviour must reach the TOKENS; (v) level count and codebook sizes are Stage-2 architecture, open to change inside the 0.15 s/epoch budget.
OBSERVATION that drove the choice: round two failed by translating items (a geodesic step toward a hub = a linear tilt of the assignment target, which is algebraically identical to moving points) and translation provably merges prefixes. Therefore the new mechanism must act on the FRAME, not on the points, and must spend the extra deep capacity in the behaviour-contrast direction instead of the radial direction.
CHOSEN MECHANISM: HOLO-TILT-SID. Per-item rotation of the level-3 residual query inside the tangent plane spanned by the radial direction and the item's successor-contrast direction; the rotation angle is the holonomy (= geodesic-triangle area) of the hyperbolic triangle (origin, prefix point, unit contrast probe), so it is 0 in the flat limit and 0 when the behaviour direction is switched off. No new loss, no coupling weight, no tuned constant. Implemented query-side, so it costs O(d) per item and no extra table.
WHY IT IS IN SCOPE: behaviour = train-only directed transition contrast per item; geometry = holonomy angle / Lorentz tangent-plane rotation at curvature c=1; coupling = the single assignment score in which the rotation plane is behaviour-given and the rotation angle is curvature-given; switches behaviour-off (u_i=0 -> theta=0) and geometry-off (c->0 -> theta=0, Euclidean metric) both exist and both reduce to the identity rotation, so only the both-on arm tilts the deep partition.
OPEN / CARRIED RISK: the flat/behaviour-off arms coincide at identity rotation, so the ablations isolate curvature and behaviour but not their product; and the reconstruction objective may shrink the level-3 residual and make the tilt inert - recorded as a monitored diagnostic rather than a gate.
EVIDENCE LOCATION: this progress file, this record; the full answer is in the next and final record.

FINAL ANSWER (summarised; full text is in the agent reply). IDEA: HOLO-TILT-L3 - behaviour-contrast holonomy tilt of the deepest residual codebook in a curvature-1 Lorentz RQ-VAE.
SIGNAL: train-only successor-contrast direction u_i = normalize(P(mean frozen text emb of i's high-mass directed successors - mean of popularity-matched non-successors)), computed once from the train split with m_i the top successors covering >=50% of i's outgoing mass and a deterministic +-20% popularity-matched control set; frozen before Stage 2.
GEOMETRY: curvature fixed to 1 (gauge fixing) on the Lorentz hyperboloid; the operator is the holonomy of a geodesic triangle - equivalently its area theta_i = pi/2 - atan(tanh(b)/sinh(a_i)) - atan(tanh(a_i)/sinh(b)) with a_i = d_L(o,x_i) and b = median item depth measured once after epoch 1 - acting as an SO(2) rotation of the tangent plane spanned by the radial vector rho at the level-2 prefix point and u_i parallel-transported and orthogonalised.
COUPLING PATH: u_i -> plane -> theta_i from curvature -> Rot_i on the level-3 residual query -> code index -> third SID token -> Stage 3. Behaviour-off (u=0) gives theta=0; geometry-off (c->0) gives area 0 and Euclidean assignment; only both-on tilts the deep partition.
CHANGE: level 3 assignment becomes k* = argmax_k [<Rot_i r_i, w_k>_p - ||w_k||^2/2], query-side, frame detached from autograd; levels [256,512,512] (capacity raised at L2/L3 to answer the prefix-capacity evidence) with 3-token SIDs and the frozen Stage-3 protocol unchanged.
COST: ~1e6 extra flops per step, <1% of 0.145-0.16 s/epoch; ~16k extra codebook floats; no new loss and no new tunable weight.
EXPECTED: >90% of level-3 indices change, distinct L3 prefixes rise above the round-one 2201 (and 1298), level-3 usage entropy rises, mean |r_3| stays above 0.7x round one; judgement = Stage-3 test_recall@10 > 0.065.
RISKS: reconstruction shrinkage making the tilt inert; a shared codebook cannot rotate for every item so reconstruction loss rises; theta up to ~50 deg may turn the deep token into noise; Stage 3 may find a behaviour-tilted L3 harder to generate.
DIFFERENCE FROM PRIOR ROUNDS: it never moves an item (isometry of the frame, not a geodesic step toward a hub), has no radial objective (so the round-one origin collapse is structurally absent), and never builds a codebook from successors; it isolates the curvature-driven angular tilt from the translation mechanisms that merged prefixes in rounds one and two.
OPEN: the behaviour-off and geometry-off arms coincide at the identity rotation, so the ablations isolate behaviour and curvature separately but not their product; recorded as a known limitation, not run.
